output.question: Who owns Raycon?
output.answer: Raycon, the consumer audio brand formally called Raycon Global, is privately held. The most recent coverage (August 2026) says it is controlled by co-founder and CEO Ray Lee together with company management. Ray J, the co-founder most people link to the brand, is no longer an owner: he sold his shares and left Raycon Global in 2024, which one source describes as a company buyback in March 2024. An earlier, less consistent site (May 2025) instead names a Delaware holding company, RAVI LLC, as majority owner, with minority stakes held by Cowboy Wholesale and Ray Lee. No primary filing confirms the exact split.

key_facts.fact: Ray J and Ray Lee co-founded Raycon. Ray J was chief strategic officer and Lee ran product development and operations. Ray J sold his shares and left Raycon Global in 2024, in a deal that may have been worth up to $100 million to him.

Raycon is privately held and controlled by co-founder and CEO Ray Lee together with company management. Ray J left in March 2024 by selling all his shares in a company buyback at an undisclosed price. No outside investors have been disclosed.
A different site says RAVI LLC, a Delaware holding company, holds the majority stake, with minority stakes held by Cowboy Wholesale and CEO Ray Lee. It gives no percentages.

caveats: Raycon is private and has no public cap table. None of the ownership claims could be checked against a primary source such as a company statement or a filing.

Sources disagree on who controls Raycon now. Revenue Memo (2026) says Ray Lee and management. BrandsOwnedBy (2025) says RAVI LLC is majority owner. The BrandsOwnedBy page also contradicts itself, for example on Cowboy Wholesale's role and location, so it is less reliable.
Ray J's former stake is poorly sourced: reports range from 30% to 61%. The roughly $100M figure for his exit is described only as 'potentially' that amount.
Raycon's official About page redirected to a Shopify page that wasn't fetched, so I found no ownership statement from the company itself.
